children: Eurozone government bond yields are little changed, struggling to find direction without guidance from U.S. Treasury markets which are closed due to Veterans Day holiday. The eurozone data calendar is thin, and so is the issuance pipeline. Only Germany lines up for government bond auctions, offering 1 billion euros in the May 2047 Bund and 1.5 billion euros in the August 2056 Bund. The 10-year Bund yield rises 0.1 basis point to 3.300%, according to Tradeweb. Ten-year bonds of countries facing fiscal challenges--France, Belgium, Italy--outperform currently, with their yields falling by more than 1 basis point.(emese.bartha@wsj.com)
